parameters.name: filter[package_status]
parameters.description: Exact match: TO_SHIP, PROCESSING, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, CANCELLED

parameters.name: filter[shipping_provider_name]
parameters.description: Exact match on shipping provider name

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Partial match on package_id, tracking_number, or related order's tiktok_order_id

parameters.name: filter[shipped_at_from]
parameters.description: Filter packages shipped at or after this date

parameters.name: filter[shipped_at_to]
parameters.description: Filter packages shipped at or before this date

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for DESC. Allowed: id, package_id, package_status, shipped_at, delivered_at, created_at. Default: -shipped_at
